name: framework
description: The (AI) Framework: a local dashboard and daemon for coding agents. It starts an agent through the project's own start hook and shows every agent from the files it keeps; it runs no coding agent itself.

scripts.build: pnpm -C ../skill-branches build && pnpm -C ../skill-tickets build && pnpm -C ../skill-queue build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p dashboard/tsconfig.widget.json && cp dashboard/widget/theme.css dist/widget.css && node scripts/copy-extension.mjs && cd dashboard && vite build
scripts.dev: pnpm -C ../skill-branches build && pnpm -C ../skill-tickets build && pnpm -C ../skill-queue build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C ../skill-branches build && pnpm -C ../skill-tickets build && pnpm -C ../skill-queue build && pnpm -C ../skill-logs build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver build && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p dashboard/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm -C ../skill-branches build && pnpm -C ../skill-tickets build && pnpm -C ../skill-queue build && pnpm -C ../skill-logs build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs && cd dashboard && vitest run

author: Suleiman Shahbari
